main_issue: Who completes Agent D's half-done analysis section for Thursday's pitch while D is bereaved: the team covering it, or D finishing it remotely

A-B.evidence: A proposed splitting D's section (T6); B refused (T7); A accepted ('understood') and moved on, later settling on D finishing it (T8, T13).

A-C.evidence: A asked C to take on work (T8); C declined (T9); A then welcomed D's plan, which fits C's view that the analysis is specific (T11, T13).

A-D.evidence: A first said not to worry and that the team would cover (T6). D offered to finish it herself (T10); A accepted: 'that would solve the problem' (T11) and thanked D (T13).

B-C.evidence: Both declined to take on D's work (T7, T9) and neither addressed the other; both sent D off with 'Take care' (T35, T39).

B-D.evidence: B refused to cover (T7) and D's own plan (T10) resolved this without B. B never spoke to D's plan, only said 'Take care' (T35).

C-D.evidence: C said she can't do the analysis (T9); D agreed ('Agent C's right') and offered to finish it herself (T10).
